about: Renders a list of items with the browser's markers, or with a mark in each item's `List.Indicator`.

align.about: The three alignments of the indicator against an item that wraps, in a 320px room.
align.title: Alignment

features.sso: Single sign-on with SAML and SCIM provisioning for every workspace

gap.about: Every gap token between the items.
gap.title: Gaps

marker.about: Every marker type. A counting marker renders on an `ol`.
marker.title: Markers

motion.about: The animation each item enters with. Each one runs once when the item mounts.
motion.title: Motion

title: List

variant.about: `plain` removes the browser's markers, and each item renders its mark in `List.Indicator`. Every other scene renders the default `marker` look.
variant.title: Plain
